text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What do you take me for? That wasn't nearly enough to exhaust me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Once we get back to the academy, we'll analyze this race. You go on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I… want to cool down a bit before heading back. I'll catch up to you, so no need to wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove claims she isn't tired, but her behavior says otherwise. It might be worth adjusting her schedule.
